title: Rho heading
description: A large regular-weight section heading (60px desktop, 36px phones, line-height 1) whose words rise one after another from under their own line as it scrolls into view, later words trailing the scroll.
notes: CSS scroll-driven (animation-timeline: view()); browsers without it, and reduced motion, show the words in place
size presets: section (60/36px) and hero (80/48px); override with className
